description: Angular component definitions for a bottom drawer UI element, including animations, container, content, and drawer classes.

classes.name: MatDrawer
classes.description: Component representing a bottom drawer with configurable mode and height.

classes.name: MatDrawerContent
classes.description: Component for the content area within the drawer container, managing margins.

classes.name: MatDrawerContainer
classes.description: Container component managing drawer and content layout, including margin calculations.

methods.name: getBaseHeight
methods.description: Returns the base height of the drawer.

methods.name: setMargins
methods.description: Sets the top and bottom margins for the drawer content.

methods.name: updateContentMargins
methods.description: Recalculates and applies the content margins based on drawer state.

methods.name: getDrawerHeight
methods.description: Returns the current height of the drawer view.
